summary: Stratasys Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its second-quarter 2026 financial results press release and slide presentation. The filing reports revenue of $137.6 million, a GAAP net loss of $16.9 million, non-GAAP net income of $2.3 million, and $212.5 million in cash with no debt. It mentions a pending acquisition of MarkForged, but provides no deal terms. This is a routine quarterly earnings announcement, not a special-situation event. The MarkForged reference is forward-looking and lacks sufficient detail for classification.
